channel.title: frontier-wire
channel.description: An openly automated bilingual news wire (RU+EN): AI, tech, science, world, culture, economy.

item.title: В Нигерии паленый алкоголь убил почти полсотни человек / Bootleg alcohol kills nearly 50 in Nigeria

item.title: Астрономы нашли самую молодую известную планету / Astronomers just found the youngest known planet

item.title: Настоящие богачи Америки прячутся не в списке Forbes / America's real rich list isn't the one Forbes prints

item.title: Кто-то целенаправленно охотится за аккаунтами разработчиков Rust / Someone is targeting Rust developers' accounts

item.title: ИИ-индустрия тихо меняет фокус: с обучения на вывод / The AI industry is quietly shifting from training to inference
item.description: For five years the race was about training bigger models. Now what happens after training — at inference time — is what matters most. (source: https://spectrum.ieee.org/inference-hardware-revolution)

item.title: Трамп отзывает кандидатуру главы ICE — агентство снова без начальника / Trump pulls his pick to run ICE, leaving the agency without a confirmed chief

(source: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/17/nx-s1-5973271/trump-withdraws-lance-schroyer-a-former-oklahoma-state-trooper-as-his-nominee-to-lead-ice)

item.title: Как письма зрителей переименовали первый шаттл NASA — 50 лет спустя / How viewer letters renamed NASA's first shuttle — 50 years on

It was meant to be named Constitution — until a letter-writing campaign changed the agency's mind. (source: https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/nasa-unveils-enterprise-the-first-space-shuttle/)
